meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能通过Signal频道以你的手机号收发消息，支持Markdown、引用回复、打字指示和给自己发消息。
howto.when: 完成设备链接并配置频道后，当有人给你发Signal消息时触发；你也可以通过给自己发消息与AI对话。

say.text: 帮我查一下明天的天气
say.note: Claude会查询并回复天气信息。

say.text: 给张三发消息说明天会议改期
say.note: Claude会通过Signal发送消息给张三。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive messages via Signal using your phone number. It supports Markdown formatting, quoted replies, typing indicators, and Note to Self.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone sends a Signal message to your number after device linking and channel configuration. You can also use Note to Self to chat with the assistant.

say_en.note: Claude will fetch and reply with weather info.

say_en.text: Send a message to John saying the meeting is rescheduled.
say_en.note: Claude will send the message via Signal to John.
